newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares fall in first Ramadan session.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares fall in first Ramadan session.

text.p: Egyptian share prices eased on Sunday as trading hours shrank for the first session in the fasting Moslem month of Ramadan.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index closed 1.84 points lower at 322.1 but volume was around its usual level at 33.05 million pounds ($9.72 million).
Medinet Nasr Housing and Development was the most active share, with shares worth 14.17 million pounds changing hands. The share rose 11.00 pounds to 412.00.

Heliopolis Housing and Development, another of the bourse's favourite stocks, lost 27.1 to 515.34 after shares worth 3.07 million pounds traded. The company announced that it will have a 10-for-one share split in February.
Egyptian Financial and Industrial was also active, rising 14.00 pounds to 155.00 as shares worth 2.70 million changed hands.
The CMAindex for openly traded firms fell to 509.39 points from 514.11 points on Thursday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms slipped to 219.79 from 220.56 points.
Out of 69 shares traded, 26 advanced, 24 declined and the other 19 ended the day unchanged.
